title: Environment and Sensor Observation Log
description: A context-first log for environmental readings, sensor identity, crop stage, observed condition, and follow-up.
instructions: Record the sensor identifier and location with every reading.
Keep setpoint, measured value, and observation as separate fields.
Use the approved SOP or responsible person to decide whether a value requires action.
limitations: No universal environmental target is implied by this template.
Verify instrument condition and site requirements before interpreting a reading.
